metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU KEUNG v. TSE FUNG PING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Severe injury to his right hand resulting in extremely serious deprivation of use of his right hand.
source: He received a severe injury to his right hand, which compelled him to leave his job in a jewellery shop. He is now unable to do either dexterous or heavy manual work.
the plaintiff has suffered extremely serious deprivation of use of his right hand.
There is some scarring from the 3 operations that were necessary

he no longer has a firm grip, he cannot close his hand, he has lost the ability properly to pronate or supinate the hand, ulnar drift, which has pulled the tendons out of alignment and which will tend to get worse and probably lead to arthritis, the combined effect of the injury, scarring and splinting has led to contraction of the muscles.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple flexor muscles or tendons at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Extremely serious deprivation of use of his right hand
Lost the ability properly to pronate or supinate the hand
Ulnar drift with tendons pulled out of alignment and likely progression to arthritis

losses.description: Loss of use of right hand causing inability to do heavy or dexterous manual work.
Can no longer follow his former occupation of a jeweller.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Used to play basketball, bowling and badminton and can no longer enjoy these activities.
There is some scarring from the 3 operations that were necessary.
